data.name: Dolat
data.gender_notes: Dolat is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Dolat is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘dola,’ meaning wealth or prosperity. In Hindu mythology, Lord Vishnu is often depicted as holding a pot of gold or wealth, symbolizing the abundance and prosperity he brings. This name is a reminder of the divine blessings of wealth and prosperity. The name Dolat carries the meaning “Wealthy, Prosperous” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dolat usually hope their child will grow to embody wealthy, prosperous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Dolat belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wealthy, Prosperous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dolat total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
